parameters.name: AuthYears
parameters.description: The authorization duration. This parameter is required when the Test parameter is set to false or is left empty. Unit: years. Valid values: 1 to 100. A value of 100 indicates permanent authorization.

parameters.name: BizType
parameters.description: The business type. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. You can use this parameter to add remarks for a specific business, such as different facial recognition scenarios of the requester or the customer identifier to be delivered. We recommend that you specify this parameter.

parameters.name: Test
parameters.description:
The test identifier. Valid values:
- true: Uses test authorization. The authorization duration is 30 days by default.
- false: The authorization duration is determined by the AuthYears parameter.

parameters.name: UserDeviceId
parameters.description: The user device ID. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. You can use this parameter to identify a specific device. We recommend that you use the physical device number. We recommend that you specify this parameter.
